samples.name: Kilele Bakery
samples.line: A Nairobi bakery where each menu item is a WebAgent: today's bread, a cake designed with you, orders Wanjiru confirms.
samples.try_this: Ask it: Are you open on Sunday? The Visit desk answers from Kilele's own hours.
walk: Ask the front desk: Are you open on Sunday? The Visit desk answers from Kilele's own hours and shows the page.
Ask the Cakes desk to price a cake for 30 people, then design one with it.
Sign up with your email and place an order. Payment runs in PayPal's sandbox, so no money moves.
Open the owner's side to see the order arrive and the custom cake wait for Wanjiru's OK.

samples.name: Classy Perfumes
samples.line: A perfume shop with search that answers, gift plans for a group, and orders the shop confirms.
samples.try_this: Search for a gift under KSh 5,000 for someone who loves vanilla. It says what's over budget.
walk: Search in your own words: something fresh for my mum under KSh 8,000.
Compare three scents side by side.
Ask the Gifts desk to plan a gift, wrapping included.
Open the owner's side to see stock, orders and questions.

samples.name: Tana Valley Times
samples.line: A local weekly whose desks answer only from published stories, with corrections, catch me up and a Friday digest.
samples.try_this: Ask how much phase one of the northern rail will cost. The answer quotes the paper's correction.
walk: Ask the Newsroom: what's the latest on the northern rail line?
Tap Catch me up for the week's stories, each with its byline.
Open the owner's side to see stories, corrections and subscribers.
